independent_sources.title: ISO 5348:2021, Mechanical mounting of accelerometers
independent_sources.version_or_date: Edition 3; January 2021; official metadata reports confirmation in 2026
independent_sources.subject_operation_and_type: Mounting guidance for contacting accelerometers and velocity transducers.
independent_sources.governing_conditions_defaults_units_exce: Mount response/fidelity depends on coupling; several environmental/alignment influences are outside the standard scope.
independent_sources.independent_semantic_judgment: Bounded mount-audit use is supported; no cart compliance or prescribed mount is established.
independent_sources.access_and_limits: Official abstract/metadata only; paid full standard not inspected. Independent vendor sources also support the mechanism.

independent_sources.title: TE Connectivity, Guidelines for Adhesive Mounting Accelerometers
independent_sources.governing_conditions_defaults_units_exce: Coupling stiffness and layer thickness affect mounted response; clean flat interfaces and adhesive temperature limits depend on the actual assembly.
independent_sources.independent_semantic_judgment: Supports characterization, not prescribing adhesive or temperatures for an unidentified cart logger.
independent_sources.access_and_limits: Full official one-page PDF parsed by web tool; direct Python request returned 403.

independent_sources.title: Endevco TP312, Guide to Adhesively Mounting Accelerometers
independent_sources.version_or_date: TP312; no explicit revision observed; URL directory is not a release date
independent_sources.primary_locator: PDF pp. 2–5, purpose/background and mount comparisons
independent_sources.subject_operation_and_type: Vendor experiments on specific transducers and mounts.
independent_sources.governing_conditions_defaults_units_exce: Sinusoidal/random testing; high-g shock excluded. Models and mounting mass/stiffness, temperature and amplitude constrain results.
independent_sources.independent_semantic_judgment: Mount dynamics and fixture comparison are justified; frequencies and adhesives are not cart specifications.
independent_sources.access_and_limits: Independent primary-source retrieval via web tool; raw excerpts preserved.

independent_sources.title: Malekjafarian et al., Railway Track Monitoring Using Train Measurements: An Experimental Case Study
independent_sources.subject_operation_and_type: Sixty non-powered bogie passes over two months on a 6-km route, compared with a Track Recording Vehicle.
independent_sources.governing_conditions_defaults_units_exce: Specific ±15 g accelerometer, 500 Hz acquisition and 5 Hz GPS; speed selection/scaling, low-speed exclusion, position mismatch and unmeasured mass/temperature constrain results.
independent_sources.independent_semantic_judgment: Supports repeated comparisons and context controls; values and thresholds are not transferable cart settings.
independent_sources.access_and_limits: Publisher landing open failed; complete official publisher-hosted PDF downloaded and relevant sections inspected. PDF URL: https://mdpi-res.com/d_attachment/applsci/applsci-09-04859/article_deploy/applsci-09-04859.pdf

independent_sources.title: Balouchi, Bevan and Formston, Development of railway track condition monitoring from multi-train in-service vehicles
independent_sources.primary_locator: Trials, discrete-fault detection, Figures 7 and 9; track-quality and conclusion sections
independent_sources.subject_operation_and_type: In-cab railway demonstrator compared with Network Rail measurement train.
independent_sources.governing_conditions_defaults_units_exce: Run 36 explicitly recaptures the same known fault as Run 25; GNSS antenna offset affects alignment. Vertical correspondence exceeds lateral; developed speed compensation was not applied in these trials.
independent_sources.independent_semantic_judgment: C1 incorrectly excludes the discrete repeat result. Final rejection is supported; this example does not validate cart detection, new-run ground truth, or universal accuracy.
independent_sources.access_and_limits: Direct publisher open returned 403. Governing passages retrieved in extensive indexed excerpts from the primary publisher, not a secondary paraphrase; author-institution metadata corroborates identity. No unrestricted full-PDF access claimed.

independent_sources.title: Tsunashima et al., Development and Operation of Track Condition Monitoring System Using In-Service Train
independent_sources.subject_operation_and_type: Regional-rail carbody monitoring history, GNSS and curvature/map position correction.
independent_sources.governing_conditions_defaults_units_exce: October 2020–August 2022; inspection/software interruptions. Sections disagree on gap start. Same train used; selected analysis left speed uncorrected. Curve geometry and GNSS accuracy limit interpretation.
independent_sources.independent_semantic_judgment: Final preserves the source inconsistency and vehicle/context limits; history is useful without becoming cart performance evidence.
independent_sources.access_and_limits: Complete official publisher PDF downloaded; relevant full sections inspected. URL: https://mdpi-res.com/d_attachment/applsci/applsci-13-03835/article_deploy/applsci-13-03835.pdf?version=1691324931

independent_sources.title: Mihăilescu et al., Experimental Study of Wheel-to-Rail Interaction Using Acceleration Sensors for Continuous Rail Transport Comfort Evaluation
independent_sources.subject_operation_and_type: Axle/body sensors and amplification hardware in specific tank-wagon runs.
independent_sources.governing_conditions_defaults_units_exce: 19.2 kS/s is a hardware capability; exports show 0.02 s steps while discussion says 50 ms/20 Hz. Empty/loaded runs used 125/110 km/h, respectively.
independent_sources.independent_semantic_judgment: Final correctly preserves cadence inconsistency and load/speed confounding; neither rate is a cart capability or pure load effect.
independent_sources.access_and_limits: Independent primary-source retrieval via web tool; raw excerpts preserved.

independent_sources.title: Jauregui-Correa et al., Method for predicting dynamic loads for a health monitoring system for subway tracks
independent_sources.version_or_date: Frontiers in Mechanical Engineering 8, 858424; 14 September 2022; DOI 10.3389/fmech.2022.858424
independent_sources.primary_locator: Experimental procedure; EMD results discussing fixed strain-gauge locality
independent_sources.subject_operation_and_type: 1:10 inclined rail rig: optical speed, MEMS motion, strain and rail-gap trigger.
independent_sources.governing_conditions_defaults_units_exce: MEMS 1594 Hz and strain 2400 Hz describe this rig; fixed strain coverage is local. Sensor paths and scale differ from the cart.
independent_sources.independent_semantic_judgment: C2 is supported; final synchronized-reference pattern and null-reference qualification are appropriate. Upstream maps incorrectly name Romero Navarrete as author; final title/DOI and reviser verification identify the actual source.
independent_sources.access_and_limits: Independent primary-source retrieval via web tool; raw excerpts preserved.

independent_sources.title: STMicroelectronics LSM6DSM datasheet
independent_sources.version_or_date: DocID028165 Rev 7, September 2017; revision history 29 September 2017
independent_sources.subject_operation_and_type: Exact register bit definitions for the LSM6DSM fourth FIFO data set.
independent_sources.governing_conditions_defaults_units_exce: TIMER_PEDO_FIFO_EN is bit 7, default 0. DEC_DS4_FIFO occupies bits 5:3; 000 disables and 001 stores without decimation. Thus FIFO_CTRL4 = 0x08 selects 001, not 000.
independent_sources.independent_semantic_judgment: Formal default supports a configuration audit. It contradicts S11’s explanation for the reported 0x08 configuration; no cart register recommendation is justified.
independent_sources.access_and_limits: Official full PDF downloaded after timeout using query URL; actual p.65 register table visually inspected. Retry provenance preserved in S09-retry.json.

independent_sources.title: STMicroelectronics AN4987, LSM6DSM: always-on 3D accelerometer and 3D gyroscope
independent_sources.primary_locator: §3.7, printed pp.13–14, accelerometer filtering chain; FIFO timestamp section
independent_sources.subject_operation_and_type: Device-specific analog/digital filtering and timestamp handling.
independent_sources.governing_conditions_defaults_units_exce: Analog anti-alias behavior depends on performance mode, ODR and configuration; digital filters and timestamp data-set arrangement require exact settings. Units and settings belong to this device only.
independent_sources.independent_semantic_judgment: Final’s configuration dependence is supported, with no inference about the unspecified logger. Carried p.12–14 locator is slightly broad.
independent_sources.access_and_limits: Official PDF parsed via web tool; independent direct PDF download timed out.

independent_sources.title: ST Community, LSM6DSM timestamp in FIFO occasionally incorrect
independent_sources.version_or_date: Question 17 June 2026; accepted moderator reply 6 July 2026
independent_sources.primary_locator: Question register configuration and Federica Bossi’s accepted answer
independent_sources.subject_operation_and_type: A support exchange about a 208 Hz, continuous FIFO report with 25 µs timestamp units.
independent_sources.governing_conditions_defaults_units_exce: Question reports FIFO_CTRL2 = 0x80 and FIFO_CTRL4 = 0x08. Reply describes 0x08 as DEC_DS4_FIFO = 000; the governing datasheet instead gives 001. Answer is tentative, not a confirmed silicon defect or erratum.
independent_sources.independent_semantic_judgment: Discovery’s “traced” wording is overstated and the carried explanation is unreliable. Final merely identifies a configuration-specific report and does not prescribe its alleged fix; this is a non-material retained lineage/source limitation.
independent_sources.access_and_limits: First-party community report and attributed moderator answer inspected; answer correctness tested against formal manufacturer register definitions.

independent_sources.title: Liu et al., Research on vibration fatigue of sensor bracket in a metro bogie based on the pseudo excitation method
independent_sources.primary_locator: Abstract; failure-mode analysis and field-test publisher excerpts
independent_sources.subject_operation_and_type: Specific C-shaped bogie sensor bracket under metro wheel/rail excitation.
independent_sources.governing_conditions_defaults_units_exce: Particular sensor mass, bolt assembly and bracket mode near 61 Hz; rail corrugation, local stress and measured excitation condition this finding.
independent_sources.independent_semantic_judgment: Bounded bracket-resonance analogue is supported; no cart frequency, fatigue, or defect follows.
independent_sources.access_and_limits: Publisher landing did not open; primary publisher indexed abstract and relevant section excerpts independently retrieved. Full article unavailable.

independent_sources.title: Siemens Mobility takes part in Network Rail trials to predict rough rides
independent_sources.subject_operation_and_type: Vendor account of GSM-R platform trial on 80 South Western Railway trains.
independent_sources.governing_conditions_defaults_units_exce: Six-month trial at about one month of operational testing; multivendor project. Page supplies early vendor claims, not independently measured performance metrics.
independent_sources.independent_semantic_judgment: Implementation context is useful; final does not adopt vendor success as validation.
independent_sources.access_and_limits: Independent primary-source retrieval via web tool; raw excerpts preserved.

independent_sources.title: NI, Anti-Aliasing Filters and Their Usage Explained
independent_sources.subject_operation_and_type: Acquisition fundamentals: frequencies beyond the usable sampled band can fold into it.
independent_sources.governing_conditions_defaults_units_exce: An analog filter before digitization and practical transition-band margin matter; a generic rate cannot establish the unknown sensor/logger passband.
independent_sources.independent_semantic_judgment: Independent corroboration for auditing bandwidth/filtering; not a new obligation or cart sampling prescription.
